backend/main.mo: Actor storing contact form submissions in a list with functions to submit and retrieve them.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-like text containing short summaries of multiple frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration defining color tokens, themes, and base styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file setting up metadata and loading the React app entry script.
frontend/PUBLISHING.md: Developer guide outlining asset checks, component references, config validation, and IC build/deploy steps.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component assembling all page sections, theme provider, floating CTA, and toaster.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section with company description, feature cards, and CTAs for quote, WhatsApp, and phone.
frontend/src/components/Certificates.tsx: Certificates section displaying Udyam Registration Certificate with preview, details, and download/view actions.
frontend/src/components/Contact.tsx: A contact section with form submission, quick-call buttons, WhatsApp link, and info cards.
frontend/src/components/electrician-anim: SVG scene showing an emergency repair animation with reduced‑motion handling.
SVG animation of an MCB switch toggling on and off, respecting reduced‑motion settings.
Renders an SVG panel wiring animation with animated wire flow, spark effects, and reduced‑motion support.
Renders an SVG switchboard installation animation with rotating screws and a moving screwdriver, respecting reduced‑motion settings.
Displays an SVG voltage‑tester animation with probe movement and blinking LED, optionally disabling motion.
frontend/src/components/ElectricianWorkA: Displays multiple electrician animation cards with reduced-motion support and a premium emergency repair animation.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Shows floating call and WhatsApp buttons after scrolling past a threshold.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders footer with company info, quick links, contact details, and a branded copyright note.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Creates a sticky header with top contact bar, navigation, mobile menu, and WhatsApp shortcut.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with animated background, branding, service highlights, and call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/components/Products.tsx: Defines a product list with pricing logic and renders product cards with WhatsApp and scroll actions.
frontend/src/components/ReducedMotionMed: Renders an image that switches between animated and static sources based on reduced‑motion preference.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Displays core and additional electrical services with images, icons, and WhatsApp/scroll interactions.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Renders customer testimonials with star ratings inside styled cards.
frontend/src/components/WorkVideo.tsx: Implements a video and montage player with upload, playback, transitions, custom images, and recording support.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identity loading, and auth client configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useMontagePlayer.ts: Implements timer‑driven slideshow state with play, pause, restart, and adjustable timing settings.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Detects the user's prefers‑reduced‑motion setting and updates on media query changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for submitting contact forms and fetching submissions via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base file defining theme variables, dark mode, utilities, animations, and layout‑related styles.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports static branding info and a generated emergency‑electrician tagline.
frontend/src/lib/montageRecorder.ts: Implements canvas-based video montage recording with image transitions using MediaRecorder and dynamic animations.
frontend/src/lib/scroll.ts: Provides smooth scrolling utilities that adjust for a fixed header height.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp Business chat URLs with optional encoded messages and exports a default inquiry message.
frontend/src/lib/workVideoPhotos.ts: Exports a list of default work photo paths for use in video montages.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme extensions, plugins, colors, and container settings.
project_state.json: Defines project state, known deployment issues, and existing feature requirements for build and deployment troubleshooting.
